purpose: Teach: 特急/合戦/乗り物/ヘルメット/反則/力士/バスケットボール/ハイキング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、特急、絶対、券、絶対、買ったの?メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — did you actually buy an express train ticket?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious. Slight lean-in, eyes bright. Wondering tone, not demanding. The question of someone who's interested in where this is going.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、歴史映画の、絶対、合戦、絶対、シーン、絶対、すごかったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The battle scene in that history film was incredible, seriously.
lines.style: Energized and vivid. Eyes wide. Leans forward as if reliving the scene. Bright attack on the opening word, pace quickens mid-sentence. Genuine enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、乗り物、絶対、好きよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You really do have good taste in stylish things, don't you?
lines.style: Warm observation. Gentle, almost marveling tone. Slower pace. Not quite a question — more of a soft statement of something she's noticed about Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、自転車で、本気で、絶対、ヘルメット、絶対、お洒落なの、絶対、見つけたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I found this really stylish helmet for my bike, actually.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick pace. Opens with a lift. Excitement in the middle — she wants Aoi to picture it. Genuine delight at having found something good.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お料理コンテスト、本気で、絶対、反則、絶対、にならないように、絶対、気をつけてね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Just be careful in the cooking contest so you don't break any rules, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Slower, caring tempo. Soft eye contact. The tone of someone making sure something matters is done right. Trailing softness at the end — worry masked as practicality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店に、本気で、絶対、力士、絶対、サイズの、絶対、お客様、絶対、来たよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer the size of a sumo wrestler came into the shop today.
lines.style: Bright, almost laughing. Quick tempo. Opens with energy. The delight of having something surprising and funny to share. Pace stays up — she's painting a vivid picture.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、バスケットボール、絶対、観戦、絶対、しに行こうよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's go watch a basketball game together sometime, yeah?
lines.style: Warm invitation. Slight lift at the start. Hopeful undertone — wanting Aoi's company. Gentle persuasion, not pushy. The tone of someone offering a small gift of time.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ハイキング、絶対、コース、絶対、おすすめあるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I know a really good hiking trail — I can recommend it to you.
lines.style: Animated and generous. Upbeat attack. Quick pace, stays engaged. The pleasure of having something good to share. Closes with a small warm cadence — offering something she knows Aoi will enjoy.
